title: [finding] A skills-root PR was queued by a sibling session ~1h after the ADR-class ruling — a ruling recorded only on cards cannot bind sessions that haven't read it
body:
Observation-class finding, filed by the skills seat (session `session_01ATJiqhFNL82YwV8udPkoqX`) per the filing discipline. Recording, not claiming.

## What happened (all readings from GitHub, 2026-08-11)

- 05:07Z — #7548 records the maintainer ruling: skills updates are ADR-class, human review/merge (「所有 skills 的更新和 adr 类似,需要人工审核」). It lives on the card and in the seat mandate (#7623), **not yet in SKILL.md on main**.
- 10:50Z — PR #7698 (the batch PR that *encodes* that ruling) opens as draft; the skills seat's ACCEPT (11:14Z, on #7631) ends at "awaiting a human merge — not queued, no auto-merge".
- ~11:20Z — the PR is flipped ready and an `added_to_merge_queue` event is delivered, actor `os-help` (shared AI identity). **Not this seat's session**; no authorization provenance anywhere. The dev session (auto-subscribed to its own PR) flagged the conflict on the thread instead of picking a side — correct per its contract.
- 11:26Z — this seat executed the documented revert: draft conversion (the only true dequeue), departure verified, flipped back to ready with no auto-merge armed. Terminal state restored; incident recorded on the PR thread.

## The structural gap this measures

A ruling recorded on cards/seat posts binds only sessions that have read those cards. A sibling session running the standard step-7 ACCEPT autopilot (review green ⇒ ready ⇒ queue) against a skills-root PR reproduces #6732's shape exactly — and the window is precisely the interval between a governance ruling and the merge of the PR that writes it into the protocol files every session loads. This instance is self-resolving (PR #7698's own diff adds the skills fork to step 7 and Guardrails; the window closes when the maintainer merges it), but the shape generalizes to any future governance ruling with a card-to-main lag.

## Non-goals

- Not re-litigating the revert (done, documented on PR #7698).
- No fix pre-ruled. Candidate shapes for whoever grades this: (a) accept the residual window as-is — rulings land on main fast enough; (b) a governance-ruling convention: the recording card immediately posts a one-line notice on every open PR whose path face the ruling covers, so autopilot sessions hit it during their own review read; (c) a mechanical guard (e.g. a required check on skills-root/ADR paths that fails while un-drafted by a non-maintainer actor) — heaviest, likely disproportionate.

Refs: PR #7698 (incident thread, flag + resolution comments), #7548 (the ruling), #6732 (ADR-queue precedent), #7631 (batch card).
